subject: Copywriting
title: Consumerism as Ideology
description: A 60-second lesson on Consumerism as Ideology.

hook.text: After WWII, America needed citizens to spend, not save. Advertising became propaganda for a new ideology: consumerism.

buildup.text: Factories that built tanks needed new markets. Advertisers reframed buying as patriotic duty: consume for the economy.

discovery.text: Planned obsolescence was the copywriter's invention.

twist.text: Victor Lebow wrote: 'Our economy demands that we make consumption a way of life.' He said the quiet part out loud.

climax.text: The most successful propaganda isn't political—it's commercial.

punchline.text: Buy for the economy. Consumerism became an ideology sold as freedom.

quiz.question: What did Victor Lebow argue about consumption?
options: Consumption must become a way of life
